subject.title: WhatsApp: add configurable send retry for transient network errors

question: Should WhatsApp outbound sends get default-on immediate retry, or should the durable queue/reconnect recovery remain the default with retry only opt-in after proof?
rationale: The code can be ported mechanically, but choosing default-on retry changes existing message-delivery semantics and duplicate-send risk for all WhatsApp users.

options.title: Port with explicit opt-in/default policy
options.body: Rework the PR on current main and keep existing no-retry behavior unless maintainers explicitly approve a default change with upgrade and duplicate-delivery proof.

options.title: Accept default-on retry after proof
options.body: Allow the PR to keep retry active by default only after maintainers accept the duplicate-delivery tradeoff and the contributor supplies live WhatsApp proof.

options.title: Close in favor of durable recovery
options.body: Close this PR if maintainers decide the write-ahead queue and reconnect drain are the product direction and configurable immediate retry should not be added now.

recommendation.title: Port with explicit opt-in/default policy
recommendation.body: Rework the PR on current main and keep existing no-retry behavior unless maintainers explicitly approve a default change with upgrade and duplicate-delivery proof.

likelyOwner.reason: vincentkoc already separated durable queue/reconnect recovery from this adjacent configurable retry decision in the PR discussion.
